title: Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage Rating Factors Table
content:
The rating factors of Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage are set per deductible option. The vehicle's physical damage base premium on the rating worksheet is rated at the reference deductible, and the option's deductible factor is the multiplier applied to that base premium.

| Deductible option | Deductible factor | Reference deductible (USD) | Loan/lease payoff option premium, percent of the vehicle's physical damage premium |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Physical Damage $2,000 Deductible | 0.71 | 500 | 6 |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $1,000 Deductible | 0.84 | 500 | 6 |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $750 Deductible | 0.92 | 500 | 6 |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $500 Deductible | 1.00 | 500 | 6 |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $250 Deductible | 1.18 | 500 | 6 |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $100 Deductible | 1.37 | 500 | 6 |

## Notes on the table

- **Deductible factor**: a decimal multiplier on the vehicle's physical damage base premium. The base premium is the figure rated at the reference deductible, so the $500 option, whose deductible equals the reference deductible, carries a factor of exactly 1.00.
- Because the factor is a multiplier, an option with a factor below 1.00 (the $2,000, $1,000 and $750 options) yields a premium below the base premium, and an option with a factor above 1.00 (the $250 and $100 options) yields a premium above it.
- **Reference deductible**: 500 USD on every option.
- **Loan/lease payoff option premium**: 6 percent of the vehicle's physical damage premium on every option, charged only when the loan/lease payoff option is carried.

*Hypothetical comparison:* two vehicles with the same base premium, one on the $1,000 option and one on the $100 option, are rated with factors of 0.84 and 1.37 respectively; the second vehicle's physical damage premium is the higher of the two.
